finding: An early native comparison treated the two source table pointers as disjoint arrays. The frozen DOS case points both tables at the same far address; the second fixture write therefore supplies the effective data for both source reads. Resolving fixture bytes by effective far address removes the trace mismatch.

reproduction.generator: Python random.Random(seed), suite._history_case followed by two full-range int16 arrays in table order

initial_mismatch.cause: Native used array 0 at the start index while the second overlapping DOS memory write had replaced array 0 with array 1.

correction: The comparator now resolves each pointer from final case memory, so duplicate far addresses use the later write for both selected graph arrays. No historical files or evidence registry were changed.
